issues.on_page: Grants 918,663 (Total Governmental Funds); funds include CDBG 34,212 and FEMA Disaster 389,656 grant income (pp20-21)
issues.issue: The statement line 'Grants' is recorded as state aid. The detail lines record the CDBG and FEMA pieces as federal grants from the fund names (detail[44], detail[69]), so receipts and detail disagree. No grantor breakdown of the 918,663 is printed, so keeping one line is defensible.

The printed function is 'Environment and leisure' (culture/recreation on every other line, and p7 counts this amount in Environment and leisure 1,229,089). The extractor took the category 'Airport', an existing name, from the fund name rather than the printed row.
This could be Sale of Property. It is an operating revenue counted in the business-type Charges for Services 14,197,347 (p2), so charges for services is defensible.
